metaTitle: Custom Full Color Plastic Vinyl | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color plastic vinyl products for your brand. Perfect for vibrant logos on giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color decoration on plastic vinyl items lets you reproduce complex logos, gradients, and photo-quality images with sharp detail. Unlike single-color imprints, full color gives you the freedom to use your brand's exact palette without compromise. This is ideal for event giveaways, retail promotions, or any campaign where visual impact matters. From custom vinyl bags to promotional accessories, the full color process ensures your artwork stands out with vibrant, lasting results.
heroAltText: Custom full color plastic vinyl products with vibrant full-color logos, including bags and accessories for promotional use.
